notes.title: The World and Gameplay Update
notes.content:
[p]Greetings fellow Dwarves! Today we are super excited to announce Orebound's latest update: The World and Gameplay Update.

[/p][p]This is a very large, exciting update that has improved many aspects of the game. There's multiple changes coming in this new update that improve multiple systems inside the game. We will write a full detailed description of what's been changed, but below is a nice summary:[/p][p] [/p][olist][*][p]A new dynamic material system for the entire game that vastly improves how the world renders. [/p][/*][*][p]Multiple Biome overhauls, new snow forest, new jungle, new woodlands, new materials for rocks and trees. [/p][/*][*][p]Major lighting changes, caves are now much darker but lights have been boosted massively to light up underground. Night lighting has also been overhauled. [/p][/*][*][p]Minecart systems overhaul. Huge changes here, mine carts can now be put into groups, filtered and split or merged. [/p][/*][*][p]Market improvements. The market now provides every item to purchase in the game as you unlock them. Also a brand new model. [/p][/*][*][p]NPC head tracking system. [/p][/*][*][p]An additional 9 minute sound track. [/p][/*][*][p]Refreshed main menu. [/p][/*][*][p]Lore in the citadel to read. [/p][/*][*][p]Hunger Re-balance [/p][/*][*][p]Notification Improvements  [/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]With the changes made in this update, we hope both returning and new players will be able to enjoy the new views as they climb the tallest peaks, or explore to the darkest depths![/p][p][/p][p]If you love Orebound and want to share your ideas, builds or feature requests, join our Discord server here: [url="https://discord.gg/tRt7KDak"]https://discord.gg/tRt7KDak[/url][/p][p]  [/p][h1]Landscape Material System Overhaul [/h1][p]Behind the scenes, we've been working hard to ensure the world of Orebound is immersive and exciting to play. One way we have improved the landscape is through new triplanar technique upgrades. These changes help make the landscape more varied and appealing while traversing the world. [/p][p]
[/p][p]Previously, our smaller-scale materials system worked decently for the first few updates of the game, but as we continue to build upon the expansive world of Orebound, we needed a stronger and improved system for our materials. One of the biggest issues we have with Orebound is getting a complex procedurally generated landscape to texture properly with multiple layers and multiple depths or angles.[/p][p][/p][p]We worked tirelessly to create our new system that not only has improved graphics for current biomes, but will also allow us to create more distinct cave layers and biomes in the future. Our new system uses pretty complex math to determine which material should be shown, which helps bring more depth and structure to the environment around you, particularly for mountains and cave entrances.  You’ll start to see more improvements in the future for below ground now that our environment generation is maturing into a much nicer state. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/993f70e79b211a74737c2be95b3a9d77105abf49.png"][/img][/p][h1]
Environment Improvements - Biome Overhauls[/h1][p]We have continued our efforts from previous updates to improve the environment presented in the Orebound by improving individual biomes. For some time, most of the biomes did not feel completely unique, which took away from the overall experience. Most biomes have seen both material and item additions. For example, snow mountains and snow areas have been overhauled and divided into two biomes and the mountains are now split between lower and upper. Each of which now contain their own models and details. [/p][p] [/p][p]Snow forests have also been improved, with new snow pine trees, snowy grass and new material outlines, making traversing the snowy lands more exciting for players visually.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/ac9542ed0f197ec1ee73b75ea8e935d402502854.png"][/img][/p][p]The rocky biome now has different rocks to make the biome more unique, including bigger boulders which may take longer to destroy, but give a high stone return.[/p][p]
[/p][p]The Jungle has now been completely redesigned with new plants and consumables and looks vastly better than before. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/23204e41619b40e7408f1514c273837057c451b9.jpg"][/img][/p][p]These changes mean that not only will the world be more immersive for new or returning players, but will allow for more distinct biomes to be added in the future.[/p][p][/p][h1]Lighting[/h1][p]
One major change we have made is the lighting in the caves. We became aware of how bright the caves previously were, which took away the mystery or the adventurous elements of looking for precious ores, and made the torches redundant. Many players asked for the caves to be darker and on our playtests we actually really enjoy playing this way.  [/p][p][/p][p]We have adjusted the caves’ lighting to make the experience more realistic, by decreasing the brightness of the caves. This now means that torches are now essential when diving deeper into the mines as you may not be able to see what lies ahead.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/e53f056498703438575b4ea474f22aec92f43b6b.png"][/img]We have increased the lighting power of all lights so people have plenty of light range whilst exploring the dark. All in all they just needed a lot of balance to get the dark/light gameplay correct. 
[/p][p]However, they are too bright for most base building uses so to counter this we have given players the ability to turn lights up or down in intensity. So now you can change the brightness of your base lights to match![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/0b8c2471027cc0d0a12d0326ff7e74a26990023b.png"][/img][/p][p]We will likely tweak these values later on depending on player feedback but we’re happy with the changes for now!

[/p][h1]Minecarts[/h1][p]Our previous minecart system did not have a lot of complex capabilities, which made organising tracks and stations difficult for players. As we recognised that minecarts have not had a fresh overhaul, we have now finished a new experimental mincart system with new UI, but also focused on how players can use them effectively in their builds. [/p][p] [/p][p]In order to help organise minecart systems, we have introduced minecart grouping, which allows players to select stations, minecarts and rail splitters to group together so they only interact with each other. This means that if there’s several stations on the same rail line, but not all are a part of the group, then the minecart will not interact with the groupless stations and will skip to the next grouped station.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/9006e0d85525936253fa4f14905fcf8e9e522fcc.png"][/img][/p][p]Two new types of rails have also been introduced to allow for more complex rail systems: the Rail Splitter and the Rail Merger. Rail Splitters have the ability to filter one side by a specific Minecart Group which allows the player to split routes and send specific carts to different areas or stations, and then after use Rail Mergers to merge back into the main route. Rail Splitters with no group will split Minecarts 50/50.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/1246a864d04958179f69f178b8676572fea8eac3.png"][/img][/p][p]Minecarts themselves now have two inventory slots instead of one, helping speed up the process of transferring goods from different stations. Minecarts don't require space to drop their entire content anymore, they'll drop whatever the station can store, and will no longer stop at full stations.[/p][p][/p][h1]Market Rework[/h1][p]The needed market changes overhaul is here! Markets now sell a larger array of useful items (now priced higher than their actual value, he’s got to make his market profitable somehow!) that previously were not purchasable, making more items accessible to players. Items can also be bought in bulk, up to the maximum item stack size, which saves a significant amount of time for players who previously had to manually purchase individual items. New items are also unlocked by upgrading your research level, giving players even more reasons to regularly check their research stations to see what they need to reach the next level. This also comes with a new model as the old one didn't quite fit. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/b8ab5b336815e99524d807c6dd56f72c9728f5b7.png"][/img][/p][h1]
NPC Head Tracking[/h1][p]This one is smaller but still vital, all NPCs, including orcs, will now track the player with their heads. This was something we wanted to get to earlier but other tasks took priority. In addition all Dwarven NPC’s have been made more unique and individual. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/264f91c6913fca89459dcb4e054c63ea97c68cfa.png"][/img][/p][p]  Update notes:[/p][list][*][p]New triplanar calculation and optimisations, allowing new landscape material.  We've added a lot here, including different top and side material display, and near and far textures with blending between them.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the navigator behavior so that it only drains mana when moving. Mana will regen when you stay stationary[/p][/*][*][p]When you obtain a Tool and there is free space in your Hotbar it'll automatically set it to that slot[/p][/*][*][p]Moved general notifications to the center of the screen[/p][/*][*][p]Added more notifications for the building tool modes[/p][/*][*][p]Details on landscape biome changes:[/p][list][*][p]The jungle biome has been changed in style to a different type of forest.  The jungle was using market place assets and the new assets are custom creations by our artist dwarf.[/p][/*][*][p]The snow forest biome has been redone, with new material outline, snow grass and snow pine trees.[/p][/*][*][p]The mountains are now actual mountains, not just snow and are split into two new biomes, the lower mountain and upper mountain.  The upper mountain goes all the way through, the lower mountain has just a hard outer stone shell and dirt inside.  Mining the stone parts of the lower and upper mountain requires a level 2 pickaxe and will give you stone.[/p][/*][*][p]The desert biome, while still barren, now looks more sandy.[/p][/*][*][p]The rocky biome now has different rocks, including large boulders that will take a lot to destroy and will give a larger stone reward.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Changed the navigator behavior so that it only drains mana when moving. Mana will regenerate when you stay stationary[/p][/*][*][p]When you obtain a Tool and there is free space in your Hotbar it'll automatically set it to that slot[/p][/*][*][p]Moved general notifications to the center of the screen[/p][/*][*][p]Added more notifications for the building tool modes[/p][/*][*][p]Minecart System Improvements:[/p][list][*][p]Minecarts will now take items from the last slots and not the first.[/p][/*][*][p]Minecarts now have 2 inventory slots instead of 1 which helps with item flow and stations that contain different types of items.[/p][/*][*][p]Minecarts don't require space to drop their entire content anymore, they'll drop whatever the station can store.[/p][/*][*][p]Minecarts that can't deposit items or can't pick items up won't do a full stop at the station anymore[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes to the station and cart collisions and rail heights.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Minecart Groups System[/p][list][*][p]The addition of Minecart Groups which is a system that will allow players to create and assign groups to Minecart Stations, Minecarts and Rail Splitters. The groups system will allow players more control and automation of their Rail Networks.[/p][/*][*][p]A minecart will only perform a stop and interact with a station if they are of the same group, it will totally skip stations assigned to other groups than itself. This allows players to control which carts can interact with which stations and thus control the flow of items by controlling the number of carts available to each station of a certain Group.[/p][/*][*][p]A minecart can be interacted with to see its contents and to change its group after it has been created.[/p][/*][*][p]The addition of Rail Splitters and Rail Mergers to allow for more complex Rail Networks.[/p][/*][*][p]Rail Splitters have the ability to filter one side by a specific Minecart Group which allows the player to split routes and send specific carts to different areas or stations and then after use Rail Mergers to merge back into the main route.[/p][/*][*][p]Rail Splitters with no group will split Minecarts 50/50[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Changed lighting values for all light based buildings in the build hammer to suit the new overall cave lighting changes[/p][/*][*][p]New icons for buildings within the first page of the build hammer[/p][/*][*][p]"Dwarfified" some in game text[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked a couple of food recipes - boar bacon sandwich, barley bread.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new items into the jungle- Blue Jungle shroom & Jungle bush[/p][/*][*][p]Dwarves are now interactable within the citadel and will have unique text.[/p][/*][*][p]Market Rework:[/p][/*][*][p]Market now sells new Items[/p][list][*][p]New items are unlocked through research[/p][/*][*][p]Buying items from Market costs more than their actual value[/p][/*][*][p]Can select any amount of an item to buy between 1 and the max stack size[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Improved NPC Visuals:[/p][list][*][p]Most NPCs now look at the player when they get near, or are being targeted in the case of orcs[/p][/*][*][p]Blacksmith dwarf now only hammers when crafting[/p][/*][*][p]Market dwarf now only waves when  you interact with him (Open or close shop)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Bug Fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Build mode switch sound now gets effected by SFX volume setting[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed clicking around Tutorial popup sometimes hiding mouse (Also takes away player movement until dismissed)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Hunger only damages the player to a certain amount[/p][list][*][p]Peaceful and Easy only damages the player to 50 health[/p][/*][*][p]Standard only damages the player to 10 health[/p][/*][*][p]Hard only damages the player to 1 health[/p][/*][*][p]Very Hard will reduce health to 0 and kill the player[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b][i]We also might be working on something special for Orebound’s 1 Year Anniversary, so stay tuned ;)[/i][/b] [/p]

notes.title: The Outpost Update
notes.content:
[p]Fellow Dwarves, we are excited to announce a smaller, but significant update: The Outpost Update.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/348372acb3b71979d7d990726e44751e34874695.png"][/img][/p][h1]The Outpost Update[/h1][p]The main focus of this update is improving the game’s performance so more players can have higher frames per second. This means more players should have a seamless experience while exploring the world of Orebound. We've achieved this through using imposters on Unreal Engine to reduce the amount of graphics your PC will have to render at a distance, [b]without losing the quality Orebound is known for.[/b][/p][p]
[/p][p]To help improve performance, we also identified areas that were being rendered when they shouldn’t be. This has made massive savings, from an average of 7 million triangles rendered down to, in some places, under 1 million triangles. For our test machines, we've seen increases between 10-20 fps, and we hope for lower end machines this should be greater.  We've taken the liberty of using some of this freed up space to increase the foliage. The pine forest is now denser and renders out further, and the grass is now thicker.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/017be2125c00961e69ff1b6362c3d30be4246b16.png"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][h1]A New Way To Build[/h1][p]A highly requested feature we are excited to finally introduce is drag lines for building. Placing individual building pieces takes a while, so the use of our new drag features to help speed up the process of building your base, giving you more time to fully explore your world. Most building pieces can be drag-placed horizontally or vertically, with the exception being stairs, which can be placed diagonally.[/p][p]
[/p][h1]Full Quest Rework[/h1][p]As a part of our mission to make the gameplay experience the most enjoyable as we can. The tutorial has been disabled and the onboarding process has seen a full and lengthy rework to replace it. The early gameplay flow is now far, far smoother and more satisfying to play.[/p][p]Quests will now automatically track and complete for the player, requirements and rewards will display in the quest HUD, and the onboarding has been redesigned to fit around the new Dwarven Outpost building, your centralised point for all expeditions! 

[/p][h1]Citadel Improvements[/h1][p]We have also been working behind the scenes on improving the Citadel and the overall onboarding process for new players. The Citadel now contains new carpets to help direct players, improved lighting to make the Citadel more lively, and new relay stations.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/07b5950a3f3dcab489a3956e9e6528a250f0c4e4.png"][/img][/p][h1]New Building![/h1][p]We are excited to announce a new building to the game: The Outpost - a central starting base camp on your dwarven adventure. The Outpost is a perfect starting base, whether you are new to the game or travelled far from your original spawn. A bed, King’s Quest Board and a chest can all be found in the outpost, making it the ideal first build you make.[/p][p]
[/p][h1]Mountains![/h1][p]There is also a change to the generator for the surface.  Mountain generation has been reconfigured.  No more random seeds where mountains take up most of the map and you’re stuck on a desolate peak, desperately searching for berries and mushrooms to stave off hunger.  Instead we’ve toned down how much space a mountain takes up, while bringing them closer together.  The result is a mix of valleys and plains along with ridges and ranges to construct your dwarven fortresses in.  The extra benefit is the land is a bit more bumpy, and endless flat prairies have been broken up.[/p][p][/p][p]To see some of the new update in action, check out our trailer for The Outpost Update here: [dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/n5i2ifl-oow"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]
[/p][h1]Future Plans…?[/h1][p]And now fellow dwarves, as if this update wasn't enough, more food for ye eyes to make your stomachs grumble in hunger and whet your appetite for our future plans.  These will not necessarily arrive in order, but plans they are.[/p][p]
[/p][p]1) Forging your own image.[/p][p]This one in particular we wanted done for this patch, but timing and resources be as they are, it is delayed. The back end continues for the character creator for you sculpt your jaw, choose your braids, colour your eyes like gems and rock.  Also introducing a new feature we're calling "the trait system".  But more on that will be revealed, later.[/p][p]
[/p][p]2) The landscape shall bloom anew![/p][p]Many have remarked the world is pretty and good, and the style unique, and aye, we have gone for style.  Though during our changes and musings, we want to make more.  Edges on far away hills and cliffs should reveal uncovered ground and sides, and the realm should pop.  The mountains will call to ye, lusting to be mined.[/p][p]
[/p][p]3) Glory of the new outposts.[/p][p]The new dwarven outpost was created by chief engineers, combining stone and wood, with fresh dwarven designs and we know, you want those pieces to incorporate into your dwarven holds.  Our plan for that involves a menu recategorization.  No more rummaging through lists of stone and wood building chaos like a drunk goblin in a gear bin.  We plan to make it that ye shall find pieces laid out neat as a master masons toolkit![/p][p]
[/p][p]4) Weaving of the world[/p][p]With the changing of the maps so that the mountains no longer dominate (not that any dwarf is not home within their sacred mountain halls) and vast planes do not stretch for miles beyond, we plan to expose these parameters in your selection, to edit and play with so you can get a world you want to enjoy!  Create realms as unique as the self carves runes on ye axe!  And of course, with this will come a visualizer, so you can see what surface you'll adventure onto.  Of course though, the deep bowels will remain a mystery you have to explore yerself[/p][p]

[/p][p]Patch Notes:[/p][list][*][p]Generation has been changed for mountains, they take up less room and are more frequent, making the world bumpier.  This only applies in new games.[/p][/*][*][p]New axe model and animation for wood chopping axe[/p][/*][*][p]All foliage and camp items have imposters, which are light weight triangle representations when they are far away.[/p][/*][*][p]The lorestone at game start finds the ground better.[/p][/*][*][p]Finding the start area now has a stronger bias for flat zones (should stop starting up sheer cliffs)[/p][/*][*][p]New Rune Line drag system, to drag place buildings.  The default hotkey is M.[/p][/*][*][p]On player death,if you are in build mode, this will now cancel.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized skeletons using animation budgeting in citadel[/p][/*][*][p]The foot IK is now off while in the airship (should stop your feet going in the air while the airship is moving)[/p][/*][*][p]Doubled the distance for placing buildings in build mode from 20m to 40m[/p][/*][*][p]Can no longer use tools while in a building's UI[/p][/*][*][p]Can no longer scroll through hotbar while in a building's UI[/p][/*][*][p]Player Inventory should now close along with building UI[/p][/*][*][p]Can no longer search for king's quest board with beacon compass[/p][/*][*][p]Added New Dwarven Outpost building[/p][/*][*][p]Can now use beacon compass to search for Outpost[/p][/*][*][p]Added a Barkeep to Citadel who gives out drinks[/p][/*][*][p]Quest and game balance changes[/p][/*][*][p]Completely disabled the tutorial [/p][/*][*][p]Fully reworked the onboarding process to be more guided [/p][/*][*][p]Quests will now automatically complete once fulfilled [/p][/*][*][p]Added the Dwarven outpost, a new base of operations for the player [/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the costs of the Toolsmith, bed and King’s Questboard[/p][/*][*][p]Rewritten the lore on the starting Lorestone [/p][/*][*][p]Added more relay beacons to the citadel[/p][/*][*][p]Added carpets to help navigate the citadel [/p][/*][*][p]Changed the default FOV from 90-100[/p][/*][*][p]You can now get drunk at the citadel Anvil bar![/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Bugs & Crashes Patch & New Milestones Met
notes.content: [p]Greetings fellow Dwarves,[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve been working hard to fix some bugs and crash issues that some have experienced this weekend. We apologise for any inconveniences this may have caused. If any issues persist, please reach out so we can sort it as soon as possible.[/p][p][/p][h2]Thank You For Your Support![/h2][p]We also  just wanted to take the time to thank every single one of you for supporting our indie game. notes.title: Orebound - Anvil Update 2: Multiplayer
notes.content:
[p]Fellow Dwarves, bring your clan to diggy hole together in Anvil Update 2: Multiplayer. [/p][p][/p][p]The long-anticipated multiplayer update is here! We heard you loud and clear, and we’re excited for you and your friends to explore the world of Orebound together. After months of hard-work and dedication, we can’t wait for you to try the new version of the game. [/p][p][/p][p]Currently, the multiplayer update is available for beta testers, but will be available to the public on Saturday 21st June 2025. Anyone who would like to get access to it early can use the code [b]updatenow321[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/d00f94049086535280c5959ed9395cc26eef3109.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Orebound Multiplayer Capabilities[/h2][p]Currently, up to 5 players are supported, allowing you and four friends to mine, go caving and build your automations. [/p][p][/p][p]Up to 10 players can play, however, this is currently experimental and will become fully supported in the future. Play at your own risk.[/p][p][/p][p]Play with either your Steam friends, or join public servers to help dwarves across the globe build a mining empire. Use custom settings to help shape your multiplayer experience.[/p][p] [/p][p]Whether you decide to all work together on the same quest, or work on individual ones, different clan members can track different quests to help build your mining factory faster. Alternatively, if you fancy making the game harder, you can also disable the quest user interface in the settings to really test your knowledge of the game.[/p][p][/p][p]Multiplayer notifications have also been implemented, meaning you can bully your clan members when they die for a dumb reason 😉[/p][p][/p][h2]In-Game Tweaks[/h2][p]On top of releasing multiplayer, we also took the time to amend different in-game UI and quality of life changes to help make the game more streamlined and easier to access. [/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/00db5aa2deee50ffc1fc8373b578cbf0fb4b67e2.png"][/img][/p][h3]Better Balanced Quests and Rewards[/h3][p]One of the most significant changes to the game is the rebalancing of quests to make them more achievable, and to give better quests rewards. This will help encourage natural progression in the game.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/b96fb82c58f77902ff5be9648dabde89db281b88.png"][/img][/p][h3]New UX For Main Menu[/h3][p]We have decided to update and improve the user interface for the main menu to help streamline the game for all users. This means that [/p][p][/p][h3]The Navigator - New UX Overhaul[/h3][p]The Navigator has also had an upgrade, which now shows improved outlines for all minable ores, making it easier to find the right ores. However, using the Navigator and the Compass now use mana, so you’ll have to be mindful of how you use these items![/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/1746bd7db3f0515f2e3ab9102ab0a58cc559cf52.png"][/img][/p][h3]Citadel Changes[/h3][p]To make the citadel more accessible and easier to explore, new carpets and signs have been added to help guide new players. There is also new added lore to the citadel - we hope you enjoy learning more about the world of Orebound![/p][p][/p][p]In the near future, we will be continuing development to the Citadel to support multiplayer and to make it a stronger hub world. Stay tuned![/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/de782a63ed6c26901e1bea7107bd904b10d8f4c0.png"][/img][/p][h3]Graphics Improvements[/h3][p]We have also reworked some of the graphics for the main menu, smelter, build menu, blacksmith, and quest menu to help them stand out more.[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: The Frameforge Update
notes.content:
[h1]Fellow dwarves![/h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/fb09facc9030dea66344944703d696ca1f9655f2.png[/img]

Grab your hammers and tighten those toolbelts — the Frameforge Update is here, and it brings with it the biggest overhaul to building Orebound has ever seen. After weeks of mining through feedback, hammering out bugs, and chiseling in improvements, we've crafted a building system worthy of your mighty underground empires.

 [h2]🧱The Way We Build Has Changed🧱[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/fb09facc9030dea66344944703d696ca1f9655f2.png[/img]
Let’s start with the big one: the introduction of Frameforge Mode — a brand new, grid-aligned building mode that makes snapping pieces into place faster, cleaner, and more intuitive than ever before.

Whether you're assembling a humble smelting hut or a sprawling industrial complex, Frameforge Mode helps keep everything perfectly aligned across long distances, even when building at angles. For those who prefer a bit more creative chaos, Freeplace Mode remains — letting you plonk and rotate to your heart’s content, grid-free.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/11158b507ec4aa55f489cc215791c0b255efe5b9.jpg[/img]

We’ve also simplified the system from three build modes down to two. Why? Because dwarves like things clear and practical. Now, every dwarf knows exactly which tool to use and when.

[h2]📐Precision with a Global Grid📐[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/fb09facc9030dea66344944703d696ca1f9655f2.png[/img]

We’ve swapped the old system for a fully global grid, ensuring that your factory lines, conveyor chains, and towering constructs all line up cleanly, no matter how deep or wide your plans go. This change alone eliminates tons of small frustrations and makes Orebound’s world feel far more consistent.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/be72d90d2378062a908de20d1b4c3459e75377bf.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/bbb0ad6a2a3234e894d3347e6a0c8ac9abc9f327.jpg[/img]

Even better, you can now choose your grid size — whether you're working on detailed inner workings or laying out huge structural frames, the grid works the way you want it to.

[h2]🔩Snaps That Make More Sense🔩[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/fb09facc9030dea66344944703d696ca1f9655f2.png[/img]
Let’s talk snap points. We heard your beard-scratching confusion loud and clear — certain pieces just weren’t snapping the way they should, and larger structures felt like they were ignoring the rules entirely. That’s fixed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/97d13acd2d9e302429760137980bcecae438fbdd.jpg[/img]

We’ve massively expanded and refined the snap point system, especially for large and extra-large pieces. Now, pieces snap exactly where you expect them to — top, bottom, sides — it all just works. You’ll even find tile snaps on the tops of foundations (yes, even the XL ones), and new bottom snaps to help with stacking.

And in response to one of the most common feature requests from you clever cave-dwellers — stone and wood pieces are now fully intercompatible. That’s right: you can now seamlessly mix and match stone and wood building components without awkward snap rejections or clunky transitions. Build with style and substance!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/a9d66a239dc0a109d959403f2813fdf3d07c8e74.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/b7d8f1c2ba83b56b8b0c282e2615a1beb7d71e7a.jpg[/img]


[h2] 🧹Smoothing Out the Cracks🧹[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/fb09facc9030dea66344944703d696ca1f9655f2.png[/img]
This update also crushes a whole heap of bugs and annoyances that were getting in the way of your creative flow:

[h2]🛠 Frameforge Update – Full Patch Notes🛠 [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/fb09facc9030dea66344944703d696ca1f9655f2.png[/img]

[h3]🌐 Core Building System Changes[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/fb09facc9030dea66344944703d696ca1f9655f2.png[/img]
[*] Changed colour of snap points from mint green to a calmer green.
[*] Reduced snap point size by 30%.
[*] Reduced snap point glow intensity by 50%.
[*] All machines now snap on the top of wood and stone block types: stone foundation, wood large foundation, large stone foundation, and XL wood foundations.
[*] Stone and wood building pieces are now fully intercompatible.
[*] Machines now use the global grid system in smart plan mode — individual machine snap points removed.
[*] Snap point size and glow reduced further for clarity.
[*] Snap point visibility can now be toggled in settings.
[*] Edge snapping for square and tile pieces is now 50% closer to the edges.
[*] Pivot points of several machines have been adjusted to better align with grid placement in smart plan mode. Note: some belts may need to be replaced to align correctly.
[*] Snap points now invalidate if a dwarf is standing where the building would be placed.
[*] Buildings can no longer be placed on top of yourself — no more accidental self-entombment.
[*] Chains can now be rotated in all directions.
[*] Snap points that share the same location now only show the first valid one, reducing clutter and visual bloom.

[h3]🧱 Snap Fixes and Additions[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/fb09facc9030dea66344944703d696ca1f9655f2.png[/img]
[*] Fixed top-of-ladder snaps.
[*] Large wooden pillars now snap properly under foundations and large wood foundations.
[*] Elevator snaps improved.
[*] Lights on chains now snap correctly when placed.
[*] Snap points added to both ends of chains.
[*] Small coin storage snap points fixed.
[*] Snap for gate corners on square piece types corrected.
[*] Small and large tile snaps now work on wood wall pieces.
[*] Belt stands now snap to each other.
[*] Wall torch lights now use grid size 1 to fix bad rotation in forge frame mode.
[*] Wood walls and wide wood walls now snap properly to stone foundation, large wood, large stone, and XL wood foundations.
[*] Large foundation snaps added to top corners of wood foundation and stone wall square pieces — now function like multiple stone foundation pieces combined.
[*] Elevator sides and tops now support snaps for square and tile pieces.
[*] Fixed splitters, mergers, and ammo splitter snaps not working.
[*] All top snaps that accept square building pieces now also accept ladders.
[*] Increased foundation bottom snap radius by 20%.
[*] Added missing snaps to foundation and large wood tile pieces.
[*] Fixed wood wall snapping too low on wood tile/stone slabs.
[*] Fixed wood railing missing top snap.
[*] Increased detection radius of side square pieces by 10%.
[*] Wall torch pivot points now set to the bottom of the mesh, consistent with braziers.

[h3]🏗️ General Building Improvements[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/fb09facc9030dea66344944703d696ca1f9655f2.png[/img]
[*] Deposits should no longer spawn in camps in new games. In existing saves, deposit locations are fixed.
[*] Fixed a reload issue with blacksmiths not accepting coins anymore.
[*] Pipes now display arrow directions during placement mode.
[*] Fixed tools not playing their animation properly when switching.
[*] Fixed ladder jumping issue when placed over the player.
[*] Fixed small brazier having collision when placing.
[*] Removed problematic brazier collision that launched players while placing
[*] Fixed snap points not reappearing when switching between build modes.
[*] Buildings now place over the player without pushing you around.
[*] Large stone foundation pieces now appear at the top of the stone section for easier access.
[*] King’s Market pivot point centered — may require rebuilding if previously offset.
[*] You can no longer take food from spit if your inventory is full.
[*] Many guideline snap positions have been adjusted to sit at the bottom of the structure.

[h3]🛡️Combat, AI, and Game World Fixes[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/fb09facc9030dea66344944703d696ca1f9655f2.png[/img]
[*] AI now falls significantly faster when in freefall.
[*] Boars no longer appear from thin air — but you might still spot them rustling through the undergrowth.
[*] Fixed walking and sprinting animation bugs.
[*] Fixed dead enemies falling through the floor a few seconds after dying.
[*] Fixed explosives not causing damage.
[*] Improved spawn detection so boars don’t stop spawning near large bases.
[*] Fixed deposits spawning inside orc camps and POIs (new games only).
[*] Barricades in orc camps now display correct names instead of showing as flags.
[*] Fixed Navigator occasionally not working.
[*] Fixed double damage sometimes being applied to weapons.
[*] Fixed double damage when weapons were unequipped while selected.
[*] Fixed missing weapon damage on game load when in first inventory slot.
[*] Chest closing sounds now respect the audio slider.
[*] Fixed not receiving the Steam reward for completing “The Beginning” questline.

[h2]✈️ Airship and Citadel Changes[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/fb09facc9030dea66344944703d696ca1f9655f2.png[/img]
[*] When pressing “Go to Airship,” lights now flash around the ship and propellers spin at half speed to signal readiness.
[*] Fixed a bug where you could launch yourself out of the airship while climbing the left turret at game start.

[h2]🧰 Blacksmiths and Crafting[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/fb09facc9030dea66344944703d696ca1f9655f2.png[/img]
[*] Fixed blacksmiths not auto-starting crafting with “refill recipe” (still requires gold input manually).
[*] Removed spam from “refill recipe” and “take all” messages when interacting with manual buildings.

[h2]Dwarven Community Highlights! [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/fb09facc9030dea66344944703d696ca1f9655f2.png[/img]
We also wanted to share with you some amazing worlds our community have been creating over the last few months! 

[h2]Desorniph's Fortress[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/fb09facc9030dea66344944703d696ca1f9655f2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/02001e82acbb61ca91c1b7f0bb6de61d485feef6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/db18544fd796e1ce4e9b3858682c0a17d7be0bac.jpg[/img]


[h2]Awesomekeksi's Megafort[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/fb09facc9030dea66344944703d696ca1f9655f2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/ff2c311370697c53024a2cb83faafe45e1b84e35.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/b1169919d6dee2456c92a7a2e8216d8691db3024.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/18c4d474f6840155c83795ff6cbea5f66f84626f.jpg[/img]

[h3]Next week, we’ll be making a massive announcement about the next update.[/h3]


If you're enjoying the game, we'd really appreciate if you dropped a review to help us out! Until then, keep building, keep sharing, and keep digging deeper.
— The Dwarven Devs

notes.title: ANVIL UPDATE 1
notes.content:
[h1]ANVIL UPDATE 1 PREVIEW[/h1]

[h1]Fellow Dwarves! Welcome to Anvil Update 1. [/h1]

This update is one of [b]the biggest yet[/b] for the game. Today we celebrate Anvil Update 1s Early… Early Access? With an epic insight into the research and development of our Dwarves. Please Enjoy and [b]share the video[/b] with your Dwarven friends! 

[previewyoutube=ey-vTveUXJ8;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]We will be setting this to “thenextupdate” branch of Orebound. [/b] It is [u][b]VERY experimental[/b][/u], but we have decided it's time to show everyone what we’ve been working on for the last few months. We have been hitting the anvil super hard. Seriously, we've been working flat out on this update... 

[b]This can be accessed in the game properties on Steam with 

password : updatenow321 [/b]

A big thank you to all our fellow Dwarven Supporters! Please drop us a review if you're enjoying the game! 

[h1]Multiple Major Feature Additions[/h1]

[h2]Stackable Belts & Stackable Pipes [/h2]
This update introduces the ability to perfectly stack belts and pipes onto each other. It’s been one of the most heavily requested features since launch and today we are delivering that in Anvil Update 1. They are awesome. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/1bddde1d1847f330a7a5b1e3fba156fef1f18795.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/616db378cc559ab00dc3c7cc1b563e36ec64b284.png[/img]

[h2]Straight Mode & Automatic Angles for belts[/h2]
We have implemented the ability to have perfectly straight belts and also added the ability to do perfect right angles on demand with the system. This will now allow players to make epicly neat factories! We also added the ability to hold CTRL to lock belts to a straight line. These also apply to Pipes and Rails.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/8ba3a837faf508ac2eebb3f823c2b9fb8bf9588e.png[/img]

[h2]New Splitters and Mergers[/h2]
Orebound now has 2 new splitters and mergers ( both are three way splits and merges ) that also stack onto each other so they should also fit with the stackable belts in perfect harmony. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/d213aeda72287ace9fe997b33dbafd363da02d61.png[/img]

[h2]New Inputs and outputs for machines[/h2]
The game now has completely overhauled input and output for machines, allowing a consistent height for all machines, we also added input and output signs for each machine to make it clearer where items go in and out. 

[h3]Warning - Belts on old saves will look misaligned but will still function correctly. If you want to fix the visual you'll need to rebuild them.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/054997126f8c0613ca5b39bfa79a80fa1b165947.png[/img]

[h2]Vertical Belts[/h2]
Today we are adding vertical belts so players can send items directly 90 up and 90 down. These work much like other vertical belts we’re sure you’ve experienced before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/6db011bd6817801c9289e3a4358357f0169c7dd5.png[/img]

[h2]Additional Base Building Pieces[/h2]
We have added over 10  new pieces to the game to make bases with. They include large platforms and more stone pieces to make interesting bases. We noticed it was taking ages to make large bases, even just to place platforms. So we have added much larger ones to save time. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/7ffed292452fc3a1132371cb54955b5fa4b3d59c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/ee7a06835c3f0aaeba17e2705d4f3c5d4ec55278.png[/img]

[h2]Optimizations of the saving and loading systems[/h2]
Players will notice saving and loading times being way faster after making a new save post-update. The save sizes also will see a big reduction up to x10 times smaller.


[h2]Major Reworks to the building system. [/h2]

The building snap system has been remade from the ground up.  It has been changed to a data on demand system instead of a constant existing system.  

This may not visibly look like a major change but we have had to completely rewrite this building system therefore there's likely to be issues here for a short time whilst we fix it up!

We figured out that for some buildings, they contributed between 200-700 uobjects, which was causing the crash and vastly increasing gameplay loading times. The limit as some of you have found is 2 million. 

This system now greatly reduces that number, improving performance from unnecessary overhead and banishing the uobject crash until you get a mega fortress running (we'll come up with ways to deal with that later).

The snap system now displays new snap indicators so you can see where to place your buildings much better than the tiny dots we had before.  We are hoping to continue improving this system in the future.

The snap system has now expanded and centralised many buildings offsets and rotations for easy snap sharing.  Yes, that means many buildings that didn't snap
before do now!



[h2]New[/h2]
We have added the following new buildings.
Wood
A half height wooden foundation.
Quarter Height wooden foundation
In large, and extra large varieties.
Extra large wood pillars as well.

[h2]Stone[/h2]
New half height and quarter height foundations.
Also in very large varieties as well.
New wall side and upper pieces to go with the new gate corner pieces.
New stair inner and outer corner pieces
New stone curved railing 3


Changes Adjusted input/output height for machines. 
Building UI now scrolls instead of having pages 
Combined Steam power and water categories 
Harvesting from farm plots now drop satchels if inventory is full 


[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
Fixed Basic Turrets not consuming ammo 
Fixed some Citadel and beacon 
UI not hiding mouse after closing 
Tentatively fixed toolbar lockup bug


Belts have had a ton of revisit and new features added. Introduced a new mode called Straight Mode where belts will automatically form in straight lines and turn 90 degrees. We also added the ability to hold CTRL to lock belts to a straight line. These also apply to Pipes and Rails.

notes.title: Orebound Update! Performance Gains, Balance, Features, UI upgrades and more!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/fb09facc9030dea66344944703d696ca1f9655f2.png[/img]
Fellow Dwarves! Today we are pushing out a new version of Orebound to "thenextupdate" version of the game. If all goes well we intend to set this live for all players very soon, probably this week. 

So if you don't want to jump in early it wont be long until everyone gets this version! 

So what have we been doing over the last few weeks?! 

We have made a pretty extensive list of everything we have done below but we will start with some general news now.

We identified three major areas that have needed work over the last few months. 

1.  Performance on lower end machines. 
2.  Object count issues with the game causing it to crash.
3.  Saving and loading times. 

This update will mainly address problem #1 which is performance on lower end machines and it also touches on point three. Loading time. We have taken the time to invest in these areas to make sure the games future is going to be epic. Why is this? Our 2+ minute loading time was just too long for a new game. We also identified extremely long load times on larger games and we have made improvements here as well ( to come very soon in the next patch as well ).

The voxel world and generator needed a tonne of optimisation. We have spent many months here and now we are happy to say that we have reduced the initial game generation time down from 2+ minutes in some cases... To [b]under 20 seconds.[/b] Yes that is correct. A new game and all its world contents can now be generated in under 20 seconds. For faster machines this might be under [b]10 seconds. [/b]

The TLDR here is that we have worked incredibly hard to breakdown exactly how the game works and optimise it as much as possible. This will now in future allow us to add more and more layers to the game. 

[h3]Improved cave lighting and better deposit rendering.[/h3]


We have spent a tonne of time improving how the game looks and feels underground. This includes allowing all the ores and the deposits to render correctly underground. We noticed that above ground ores would render fine but below ground they would not. This update fixes this so gems and gemlike materials now look very nice and shiney! 

We also gave caves a small make over to make them look nicer. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/7bde4e9430636316c9b272b66e90bf801bae4803.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/94630e66409a7eaeb494e9e374d04ca71f027803.png[/img]

The following is the new balance changes.

[h2]Research station changes[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/fb09facc9030dea66344944703d696ca1f9655f2.png[/img]

[h3]Factory and automation:[/h3]

[*]  Automation 2  reduced  from 2500 gold and 25 iron ingots to 1500 gold and 10 iron ingots.
[*] Automation 3  reduced  from 5000 gold, 25 iron cogs & 25 iron plates to 3000 gold and 20 iron plates.
[*] Automation 4 reduced  from 75,000 gold and 100 copper ingots to 50,000 gold and 50 copper pipe-works

[*] With so much new content being added to the game (and even more on the way) we realised how difficult it was to explore all aspects of gameplay in the early tiers of the game when the player has less access to gold.
[*] These changes have been made to help get the early game flowing quicker into automation while also reducing the grind factor of the later tiers to help improve the feel of the game.

[h3]Dwarves vaults:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Tier 1  reduced from 1,000 gold to 500 gold
[*] Tier 2 reduced from 5,000 gold to 2,000 gold

[/list]

[h3]Crafting[/h3]
[list]
[*] Tier 2 reduced from 5,000 gold to 2,500 gold
[*] Tier 3 reduced from 20,000 gold to 10,000 gold
[*] Considering the upgrade station requires resources to upgrade it as well as the initial research requirements, we wanted to make it easier for players to explore the tools and weapon variety’s we have in game.
[/list]

·       Copper tier reduced from 2,500 to 750 gold
·       Gold and silver reduced from 15,000 to 5,000 gold
·       Gemstones reduced from 30,000 to 15,000 gold
Copper was far too highly priced for the early stages of the game and for a game about digging, we want to make it as easy as possible to find the treasures of the world!
 
[h3]Food & farming[/h3]
·       Tier 1 kept at 500 gold
·       Tier 2 reduced from 1,500 to 1,000 gold
·       Tier 3 reduced from 5,000 to 3,000 gold
·       Previous tier’s 4 and 5 have been merged into one, costing 10,000 gold.
 
With food being a vital part of survival now, it was important to make it accessible to the early stages of gameplay. We also decided to merge the potion & automated farming stages into one.
 
[h3]Base building[/h3]
·       Tier 1 reduced from 2,500 gold to 500 gold
·       Tier 2 reduced from  5,000 gold to 1,000 gold
·       Tier 3 reduced from 7,500 gold to 2,000 gold
·       Tiers 4 and 5 have been merged into one costing 3,000 gold Base building was unjustly expensive for the player to gain access to. It is now far cheaper to allow for a much more unrestricted fortress building experience!

[h3]Explosives[/h3]
·       Tier 2 reduced from 10,000 to 5,000 gold
·       Tier 3 reduced from 50,000 to 25,000 gold
The barrier of entry to explosives was previously a bit too high and this has been reduced now.
 
[h3]Transport[/h3]
·       Tier 1 reduced from 2,000 to 1,000 gold
·       Tier 2 reduced from 7,500 to 5,000 gold
Keeping with the general theme of allowing easier access to gameplay aspects, we reduced the costs of transportation too
 
[h3]Defences[/h3]
·       Tier 1 reduced from 1,000 to 500 gold
·       Tier 2 reduced from 5,000 to 2,500 gold
·       Tier 3 reduced from 15,000 to 7,500 gold

Turrets and traps are a great feature of the game and we want players to be able to line their base with them more easily.
 
 
[h2]Building cost reworks[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/fb09facc9030dea66344944703d696ca1f9655f2.png[/img]

These changes will help the early game and onboarding process feel less resource demanding & improve the general feel of gameplay.

·       Water pump reduced from 5 iron plates, 5 iron cogs, 20 wood to 5 iron plates, 5 iron cogs and 15 wood

·       Boiler reduced from 5 copper plates, 5 copper pipes and 5 iron cogs to 5 copper plates, 5 copper pipes and 15 stone
·       Auto boiler reduced from 20 copper ingots, 20 iron ingots, 15 iron cogs to 5 iron pipes, 5 copper pipes, 10 copper plates.
·       Belt container reduced from 30 wood and 10 iron ingots to 20 wood & 10 iron ingots.
·       Large belt container reduced from 40 wood and 10 iron ingots to 30 wood and 10 iron ingots
 
 
[h3]Full Machine building reworks[/h3]
·       Auto market changed from 20 iron ingots, 4 gold ingots, 4 silver ingots to 25 wood and 15 copper plates
·       Gem cutter increased from 20 iron ingots, 10 gold ingots and 10 silver ingots to 20 iron plates, 10 gold pistons, 10 precise pipes and 10 precise gears

·       Combinator changed from 40 iron plates, 40 silver filters, 10 silver rods and 10 gold gears to 20 iron plates, 15 silver filters, 15 copper plates and 10 gold gears
·       Minecart station changed from 20 wood, 10 copper plates, 10 iron plates, 5 copper pipes and 5 iron cogs to 20 wood, 10 copper plates and 10 iron plates.
 
[h3]Unchanged Machine Buildings[/h3]

notes.title: Game reworks and world optimsation improvements!
notes.content:
[h2]Fellow Dwarves! Surprise update! [/h2]

We have been working on the next update over the last 10 days and we are happy to announce we are putting a up an experimental build to the next update branch.

Inside the game you will see, Three Brothers and Three Brothers experimental. 

[h3]What is Three Brothers Experimental? [/h3]

Over the last month, we have been swapping out Four major components of Orebound with better versions. It’s taken a lot of player feedback and analysis of where both the CPU and the GPU is hogging resources in the game. We’ve spent hours going over data that has shown us where these areas are. 

This update is epicly experimental so we have put the update on “the next update branch” 

[h3]Let us also warn that these changes are so massive they are NOT backwards compatible to your old games but they also will not break them. So you will eventually see these changes on a new game that you start! [/h3]

We cannot guarantee this version will be fine so only move onto this branch if you are happy to experiment! There be dragons! 


[h2]So what have we done?[/h2]

[h3]1.  World Rendering and Generation. [/h3]

We have changed how the entire game world renders. We have managed to gain significant performance gains by testing out various configurations of rendering/loading voxel data. We have managed to gain huge CPU performance in this area and we have also managed to reduce loading times significantly. CPU’s should have a much easier time calculating and the loading time for example has dropped from 120 seconds to around 10/20 seconds. That’s right. We can now load a new world in under 30 seconds. So a massive reduction here. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/e3e864924743b04cf948db53e628c4e51daa8c01.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/a15c38a05c670d60fbc6595fc40299d0d8014c0b.png[/img]

[h3]2. Factory Item Optimisation. [/h3]

A new backend system for moving items on the belt that is all processed by the graphics card, once again shifting away from use of the CPU and should allow for handling of thousands of items while mitigating lag. This huge change should allow for late game mega factories to have remarkably less lag.


We have also completed the change over of major character stats to using unreal engines Gameplay Ability System (GAS), which is the same system Epic uses for Fortnite for example.  This allows for us to a lot of complex and replicated stat modifications relatively easy and we are looking forwards to expanding on this in future updates with new features.

[h3]3. Inventory input output Optimisation. [/h3]

A back end inventory optimisation has been done as well which should vastly increase processing speed, increasing CPU performance. We spoke earlier this year about how input and output was causing lag when dealing with large amounts of objects. We have optimised this once again to allow us to gain more performance. 

[h3]4. Cave Generation Reconfigured. [/h3]

Caves are now larger to allow players to build bases without having to dig tonnes of area out. We watched players play and gathered feedback and so many people were telling us they wanted more underground space to build. So we have reconfigured the game to allow more space underground and we have also added tunnels that generate cave to cave so you can discover vertically and horizontally. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/f8fb7bf2178b3bb4995ba52a6f7086bb1a8b490d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/ff200528d5086be1bf820ea2a36cd43554d7d836.png[/img]

[h3]So what does this all mean?[/h3]

It means we now are able to expand into deeper cave layers, and add more to the world. For example we have extended the range and the items in the world. Tree’s will stay loaded in at a further distance. Grass will render further and much more. 

These are the changes we needed to make to allow us to push deeper down and load more layers and allow players to make gigantic factories whilst they do so. 

Getting the game to run smoothly with massive factories and also voxel worlds has been a huge technological challenge that we are finally starting to crack. This will lay the foundation for the games future. 

That's about it for now and please let us know in the discord or the steam forums what issues you get on the new update. Thank you everyone! Below is even more changes and fixes! We hope to set this live after some proper testing ( maybe weeks ) with even more improvements to the game. Thank you so much for your continued support! 



[h3]Bug and Changes List [/h3]

[h3]Large Deposits are now infinite![/h3]

We decided based on player feedback that once you find a large deposit, they are infinite. This means once you go deeper into the world you can set up your drills and keep those deposits. No more moving. We initially thought this might be fun to allow the player to keep exploring. But it wasn't. Enjoy never having to move drills again!

[olist]
[*] A new option is added in the settings to disable mouse scroll for the hotbar.
[*] Food now has unique meshes when on belts.
[*] Loading game will clean up old corrupted belts.
[*] Potion bottles on belts texture has been tweaked
[*] Boar carcasses move on belts.
[*] You can now sprint for about 20 seconds.
[*] Camps will now not display until several hundred meters away, reducing lag from faulty rendering.
[*] Doubled Elevator speed
[*] New Building Instructions UI to make changing build mode more obvious
[*] Lowered Build hammer animation
[*] Take all now plays looting sound
[*] Removed Guided/freeplay option
[*] Added new message for some maps
[*] Added new option to use standard lighting instead of lumen or screenspace.
[*] Items can now be merged in the hotbar.
[/olist]

[h3]Bug Fixes [/h3]


[olist]
[*] Some fixes to the boss orc deciding not to attack the player in certain cases.
[*] A world generator error that was incorrectly sizing caves of certain size has been fixed, and will take effect in the new experimental world.
[*] Orcs that float in their camps should now find the floor without having to move first.
[*] Fixed Bug where blacksmith didn't need gold.
[*] Fixed Bug where turret damage wasn't upgraded.
[*] Quit to desktop confirmation now resets when leaving main pause menu.
[*] Fixed Tnt and demo charge having the same explosive radius.
[*] Fixed Auto water pump not having coal item filter.
[/olist]

notes.title: Quality Of Life Update
notes.content:
Fellow Dwarves!  ⛏️  Yesterday we set the next update live onto the main games branch. Quite a few things in there and It’s now live to all players. I'll list them below! 

[h2]New features[/h2]

Herbs have been added as a growable to farm plots

Herb seeds can be gotten with a random chance from herb bushes.

Key input rebinding has been changed to be less of a hassle.  This was an issue for some.  If a key is already bound, you'll be asked to confirm setting that key and it will remove the already bound key from its binding.

Added a progress bar in the Machine UI to display crafting progress

[h2]Changes[/h2]


Due to new dwarves STILL struggling to find the relay in the citadel, it has been moved to be closer to your bedroom.

Improvements to AI inside of the tutorial map to stop them getting stuck on each other.

Boar spawning has been increased by 20%

Fixed snap points of new tiles on stone foundation and square stone pieces.

Changed crafting recipe for navigator from ruby ingots to ruby ore

The player now has a few cooked boar meat when they start

Different alcohols now give different inebrations.

Altered vsync checkbox size in settings.

Instructions in toolbar now update keybinds displayed

One of the tutorial quests no longer consumes an item on completion

Typo fix up on tool stations

Typo fix up on quests (English only)
 
[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]

You should now not be able to complete a quest unless you have the necessary inventory space.

Blacksmith returns contents when destroyed.

Fixed a small bug that wasn't allowing items to be shift clicked into the Minecart Station

Fixed a bug where you could stack items of 1 stack max (Tools)

Fixed cost consumption and refund for long belts

Please let us know if you have any questions or issues. 

[h2]The future [/h2]

We want to take a moment to discuss Orebound and what we are currently working on for the end of the month.  🔧 

[h2]Adjusted plans slightly based on player feedback[/h2]

We are delaying the new map and will pick a new date for that in the near future. We got very excited about adding a new map to play that was custom made, however after hearing the community we feel there's more important things to come first.  We are still working on this bespoke experience and it will be great when it’s done. 

So what are we doing?  🤔  Well we’ve read your feedback, read all the reviews ( literally all of them ), watched gameplay and seen what still needs to be done. 

Quality of life is one of the biggest areas that need improvement, so we’ve pushed that forward, after that we are also working on how our factory system works. We understand how slick and polished this needs to be. So many people want stands for belts, want the ability to snap belts in lines, and have more functionality to make a base without  frustration. Improvements to splitters and snaps for factories etc. We think there's a lot here that will make everyone's experience better and we want this to happen now so it’s all done for the future. 

The key rebind system also needed an overhaul which is in this version of the game now. We set up the keybind system when we didnt have many keys in the game. As this grew it caused issues. So this needed a work ( currently in this update.  )

We have noticed some players are turning on and off build systems without knowing it. Causing frustrations. Orebound contains an extremely powerful build system so it’s important we make sure that the quality of life for these tools is really good. Something we want to work on in January and February. 

So we have decided to work on that for the next few weeks but this is also alongside two other major things.

We have made some huge improvements to performance and massive factories with a new asynchronous system for belt items. This basically means you will be able to have thousands of items on belts without a CPU slow down. Something that is a big pain point for some people and something everyone will encounter eventually with a mega base. This will be a massive improvement.

We have also made changes to how items are registered inside inventories and storage. Our inventory system, for example how we detect things going in and out at scale, was inefficient and caused performance issues. Again this will be another massive improvement.

We hope rolling all of this out will ease up on CPU usage for the game for the factory side of things and essentially mean you can build anything without major performance loss.  💪 

[h2]We will demonstrate these soon after we are done testing them. [/h2]

There are two other areas we need to improve on. One is the navigation and the other is the voxel landscape. Both are quite CPU intensive; these are the next areas we want to focus on ( in terms of optimisation ) to make the game even better in the future. These are more long term. 

We are also ever closer to putting our GAS system live for the RPG aspect of the player. @deathwyrm has done some great work here and it’s going to allow our RPG game to go up multiple tiers of quality. 

We plan to roll out as much as we can for the end of January 2025 and keep working of course releasing more updates throughout the year. 

All of these additions will build a solid foundation for Orebounds development over 2025 and we cant wait to bring you more awesome updates! 

[h3]Thank you fellow Dwarves for your continued support! Please remember to drop us a review if you’re enjoying the game. We’re a small team and it really helps us out![/h3] 🙏

notes.title: UPDATE 3 - Farming, Crafting and building Update!
notes.content:
[h3]Fellow Dwarves! We hope you’re doing great! Tonight we are putting the Food and Farming update live! [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/db36c78b29a94ac25420e5775ef7e1e0b51766d8.png[/img]

[h3]This update is quite a large one so it’s taken us just over 5 weeks. We want to explain why![/h3]

Starting off with some annoying news. We have had to postpone the Brewking and the Orge map release that was scheduled for today. We have made great progress here but we need to do more and we’re not quite happy with the quality. The Brewking and the Ogre map is a custom bespoke map with its own quests and it’s taking slightly longer than expected. We have rescheduled this for the next major update in January 2025. We’re sorry for doing this to our fellow dwarves however we were not satisfied with the quality and we already had much to do. However, here's a sneak peak of the level. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/9d144de088581c71ccfa445c83906f73ef97df49.png[/img]

[h3]Everything else from here is good news! [/h3]

After the launch of Orebound we identified some of the larger issues that were in the game. This being optimisation, bugs, crashes, navigation issues etc. We rapidly got to work fixing these issues and put out hotfixes and two large updates to help with these things. 

Some of the bugs were deeper than we initially thought. Be it on older pc’s lower end CPU’s and the likes. 

We knew when we set out to make Orebound we would need to try and push some limits or we would end up being just another factory game. 

This is not where we wanted to be because although this probably would have led us to short term success it wouldn't be a long term impactful change to the genre that would be interesting and expandable over the longer term. 

What we have been doing over the last month is watching, listening, gathering feedback from the community and from refund notes ( this is a horrible place ). When we launched we knew our roadmap would change with feedback. 

We didn't initially want to put a roadmap out because we agreed that when thousands of players hit the game that would just burn the map because we would listen to that feedback and change it anyway.

What we’ve learned since launch is that you all want more in all areas, which is great and that’s what we intend to do. However some areas need more work than others, totally understandable and we wanted to get a decent approach on this. 

What we initially set out to do was to work on all areas at the same time and bring the game up at an even pace. However we have actually changed how we are going to approach this. 

What we are now going to do is focus all our energies into one or a few places at one time. So going forward that’s likely what you’ll see in our update patterns. 

What this means now is that we are going to make a roadmap that focuses on specific areas for the game and release those accordingly. We’re hoping to have something to show you all in Jan 2025 on the exact development trajectory for Orebound! 

All that being said, we have a lot to share today! 


[h3]Technology[/h3]

In the back end, we have part integrated the unreal engine Gameplay Ability System for hunger and inebriation. GAS is incredibly powerful with it's abilities, effects and modification system which is going to allow us to do a lot in the future. We visualise different food giving different buffs to speed, health regenerations and a whole host of other possibilities we are fleshing out. It also comes out the box with multiplayer support and replication, saving us a ton of time with what we'd have to test with our old current system that is being phased out. We are still in the process of integration, but it's such a big technological change that it's worth being mentioned.

We have also been implementing and improving a full quest system and quest tracking system into the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/b269ec590aa48a580d42c07499acb5a6ae92ff6a.png[/img]

[h3]Farming! [/h3]

New farming system with placeable farm plots in small, large, small with earthstones and large with earthstones.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/5884d811d7460d2c3c0f67e3fdd1c730445791f4.png[/img]

Earthstone integrated farm plots produce more and are faster.
New sprinkler that the farm plots need to grow, included an automated sprinkler system.
New foods, barley bread, and boar bacon sandwich.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/0f1f8475af68efa792398e95c93f7726944f74c8.png[/img]

A new hunger mechanic with 4 hunger states. Starving, hungry, satiated and well fed.

During starving, you will take continual damage until dead or hunger is restored.

When satiated, health will regenerate by a small amount.

When well fed, health regenerates at double the well satiated rate.

When dieing, 35 hunger will be restored every time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/ca8cc4b57c02f3678b98622ee9bac772fc350e51.png[/img]

Hops and barely is now split, into hops, and barley, and growable on the farm plots.

Changes to the icon for the hops and barley instead of that wheat icon.

New growable, berries and its seed.

New growable, mushrooms and mushroom spores.


[h3]Brewing! [/h3]

He have also introduced brewcraft to the game. This will allow players to brew ales and whiskeys and have a fun time! You'll be able to restore health and hunger, but there might be some side effects...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/ecc74f53cc941a738c517108493f69c8c9d05eb7.png[/img]

[h3]New Building Pieces [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/965744235c8d0ea69f360da0ae3fc853d51b0eb1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/3c7675a7bf22425c4e4ac65e2a0e70590c27f05b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/0019f539f636406555d040c37459e0b40cfc4ed4.png[/img]

[h3]Bug fixes.[/h3]

Some of these are for the previous 0.0.0.50d patch

Some input control fixes.

Fixes for orc weapon offsets

Switching hotbar forces end of blocking

Back end boar spam when failing to find a path should stop

Fixed bug when cave foliage wasn't spawning

Fixed player not being at save location

Scrolling to empty hotbar removes last details of button

[h3]Custom Foliage[/h3]

We are starting to add more fully custom foliage to the game to add more variety to the world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/4436be42623b67e66668781971da4ea168603804.png[/img]

[h3] Tutorial Level [/h3]

Orebound is a huge and complex game, we have received many requests for a tutorial so here it is!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/a4f9670141cbb593152358101cd0fb1e6a81c902.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150706/3a990e8a80725d7f615f88d899fb0b057d681f29.png[/img]

We’ve added a new map in which a new player can exclusively learn the core basics of Orebound through a series of quests. This was one of the highest request things from new players. Now you can practice -Collecting basic resources -Making tools using the crafting bench -Using the Ore Navigator to search and mine for resources within the Voxel world -Unlocking new tiers in the Research station -Smelting ingots & using them to craft items in the blacksmith -Making use of the Kings Market to earn money -How to place the portable drill for early-tier automation -Making use of wild plants to make food -Hunting boars and how to get food out of them -Mining automation with a large belt fed drill -learning about steam power with water pumps and boilers -Basics of in game combat -Practice fighting goblins -Achievements for completing the new level

[h3]Changes / Fixed[/h3]
Performance optimizations for the Factory side of the game. Players should notice better performance on large factories.

Fixes and polish to various UI.

Fixed the auto-boiler having the Water on the wrong side in the UI.

[h3]Future[/h3]
More work on factory optimizations, including more performant and efficient ways to render belts and their items, as well as better backend handling of inventories and the entire factory backend process.

Soon we will release an in depth update road map of what our plan is for Orebound. Also we hear you. You all want multiplayer! 

We shall keep hammering the anvil! 

Thank you!

The Dwarven Developers.
